tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere. Every text token is checked on it.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Alternating hypothesis bands in trial charts. Never a page or block ground.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Ground of code blocks and diffs, like a pasted-in printout.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between entries and event rows, chart gridlines, the budget meter track.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: The rule under the facts row and the wiki quote rule (decorative lines, not text).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, figures, ids; text on paper 14.9:1, paper-deep 13.8:1, paper-raised 15.8:1, diff-add 14.0:1, diff-del 12.9:1.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Evidence sentences, lede, event notes, empty states; on paper 8.5:1, paper-deep 7.8:1, paper-raised 8.9:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Margin notes, labels, breadcrumbs, chart ticks, proposed/dropped stamps; on paper 5.7:1, paper-deep 5.3:1. The lowest text contrast in the system.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ink tooltips (14.9:1).

tokens.name: supported
tokens.usage: Supported and confirmed stamps, passing checks; on paper 7.0:1. Always with ✓ and the word.

tokens.name: refuted
tokens.usage: Refuted and unconfirmed stamps, failing checks, the lockbox seal, exhausted budget; on paper 7.6:1. Always with ✗ and the word.

tokens.name: inconclusive
tokens.usage: Inconclusive stamps; on paper 5.9:1. Always with ? and the word.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Running and challenged stamps; on paper 8.0:1.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, toggles and wikilinks: blue-black means go somewhere; on paper 8.0:1, underlined on hover.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px; 8.0:1 on paper, 7.4:1 on paper-deep.

tokens.name: noise-bar
tokens.usage: The dashed noise-bar line and its label on trial charts; 7.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: decider
tokens.usage: Underline under the first failing rule in a check ledger.

tokens.name: frontier
tokens.usage: Frontier step lines and kept-trial dots on trial charts.

tokens.name: trial-dot
tokens.usage: Discarded-trial dots on trial charts: faint beside the frontier but 3.3:1 on paper-deep and 3.5:1 on paper, so the cloud of tries stays visible.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Ground of added diff lines; ink text 14.0:1; the line also starts with +.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Ground of removed diff lines; ink text 12.9:1; the line also starts with −.

tokens.name: diff-hunk
tokens.usage: Ground of @@ hunk headers; ink-muted text 4.8:1.

families.serif: "Noto Serif CJK SC", "Source Han Serif SC", "Songti SC", STSong, serif
families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
families.reading: "Noto Serif CJK SC", "Source Han Serif SC", "Songti SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Noto Sans Mono CJK SC", monospace

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Direction question and experiment title. One per page.
styles.sample: BTC 永续日线：时间序列动量在扣除成本后是否仍有超额？

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Workspace title and wiki page title.
styles.sample: 资料库 · 时间序列动量

styles.name: entry-title
styles.usage: Hypothesis title, direction row, evolution-ledger patch name.
styles.sample: 波动率目标仓位的动量

styles.name: entry-id
styles.usage: Hypothesis id and generation number in the margin column.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Status stamps and the lockbox seal glyph only.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Wiki page body and rendered skeptic reports; 36em measure.
styles.sample: 时间序列动量指资产自身过去收益对未来收益的预测力，与横截面动量不同。

styles.name: body-md
styles.usage: Evidence sentences, lede, ledger descriptions; 40em measure.
styles.sample: 验证段 Sharpe 1.21，DSR 0.97（N = 412），PBO 0.22，子区间为正 3/3。

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Margin notes, checks, events, toggles, breadcrumbs, footer.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Kickers, fact labels, group and section headings.

styles.name: data-md
styles.usage: Figures in rows; tabular numerals, right-aligned in columns.

styles.name: chart
styles.usage: Chart ticks, band labels and chart tooltips.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, diffs and hashes. Never wraps; scrolls inside its block.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-word gaps, stamp vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and its stamp; inline check items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Above and below every entry rule.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between facts-row items on mobile; code block side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections: facts, chart, groups, event log.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top bar to kicker; bottom of page to footer.

tokens.name: margin-col
tokens.usage: Width of the margin column on desktop (110px on tablet, folds inline on mobile).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between margin column and main column on desktop.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page width on desktop, centred.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of interface prose (lede, evidence).

tokens.name: reading-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of wiki reading text.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: stamps, code blocks, tooltips, meters.

tokens.name: radius-seal
tokens.usage: The lockbox seal ring only.
